w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Spool: Feed it nothing. It records your strikes and plays them back. Give it waits and heals while it records and the replay is silence. (Agnese lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Ad Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Agnese to Wanjiru, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 7,211 of 14,000 kcal."
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/12/6), with 7 wave-4 and 4 wave-5 fought, 12 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 19 · Craft 11 · Talk 18 · Explore 43 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
